name: bblitec
description: Experimental Babylon Lite TypeScript-to-C++ transpiler and SDL3 native runtime.

scripts.test:upstream: npm run build && node dist/src/api-command.js check && node --test "dist/test/upstream.test.js" "dist/test/compiler-architecture.test.js" "dist/test/compiler.test.js"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:ts && npm run lint:tools && npm run patches:check && npm run lint:cpp --
scripts.lint:ts: eslint src test tools checks/plugins eslint.config.mjs --max-warnings 0
scripts.lint:tools: npm run build && node node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.lint:cpp: npm run build && node dist/src/code-quality.js lint
scripts.format: prettier --write "src/**/*.ts" "test/**/*.ts" "tools/**/*.mjs" "checks/plugins/*.{js,mjs}" "*.{json,mjs}" && npm run build && node dist/src/code-quality.js format --write
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "src/**/*.ts" "test/**/*.ts" "tools/**/*.mjs" "checks/plugins/*.{js,mjs}" "*.{json,mjs}" && npm run build && node dist/src/code-quality.js format
